---
name: Compatibility report
about: A loader / Minecraft version combination works or fails with MCAT
labels: compatibility
---

**Combination:** loader, Minecraft version, loader version

**What you ran:** `mcat mod init/build`, `mcat test mod`, `mcat migrate ...` (exact commands)

**Result and evidence:** build log tail, server log lines, `report.json` from `mcat test`.

Only executed results can be added to `compatibility.json`.
